page.content:
Marvel Comics universe of heroes, villains, and the MCU.

How Marvel connects

  • Creator: Stan Lee — Stan Lee helped create the Marvel Universe.
  • Creator: Jack Kirby — Jack Kirby co-created core Marvel mythos.
  • Work: Marvel Cinematic Universe — The MCU adapts the Marvel Universe.
  • Faction: Marvel Comics — Marvel Comics publishes the Marvel Universe.
  • Faction: Avengers — The Avengers are central to Marvel.
  • Faction: X-Men — The X-Men are central to Marvel.
  • Faction: Fantastic Four — The Fantastic Four launched modern Marvel.
  • Faction: Guardians of the Galaxy — The Guardians are Marvel's cosmic team.
  • Work: Fantastic Four (2005 film) — The 2005 film is a Marvel screen work, not a parent of the MCU.

What is Marvel?

Marvel is the shared comic and screen universe built around Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, and Steve Ditko creations—the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy, Spider-Man, and the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

Key threads lead to Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, Marvel Cinematic Universe, Marvel Comics, Avengers and X-Men.
